With Amazon’s full Black Friday event in motion, we’re seeing expanded and increased Green Deal savings following suit. Our headliner for today is EcoFlow’s newly expanded Black Friday Sale starting from $459 , with up to 52% initial discounts on power stations alongside a bonus extra savings code. Right beside that is the brand’s 72-hour flash sale, with up to $1,100 discounts across new models, like the DELTA 3800 Gen4 Power Station at a $1,614 low , among others. That’s not all, as Segway has finally expanded to its full Black Friday EV Sale , with increased savings, new lows, and first-time offers, like the latest Xyber Air Smart Electric Bike at a new $1,800 low . We also have expanded savings from Velotric on e-bikes at up to $740 off, a returning EGO Multi-Head 15-inch String Trimmer combo kit low, and more. There’s the deals from the last three days at the bottom of the page, like yesterday’s ENGWE Black Friday e-bike deals , and more.
Head below for other New Green Deals we’ve found today and, of course, Electrek ’s best EV buying and leasing deals . Also, check out the new Electrek Tesla Shop for the best deals on Tesla accessories .
EcoFlow’s official Black Friday Sale cuts up to 52% off power stations + bonus savings – all starting from $459
EcoFlow has officially launched its full expanded Black Friday Power Station Sale , complete with bonus extra savings, 2x member points from purchases, and more. A favorite among the massive lineup (which includes the new TITAN and DELTA Gen4 series) is the DELTA 3 Ultra 3,072Wh Power Station down at $1,300.55 shipped , after using the sitewide code EFBFCMAFF at checkout, beating Amazon by $68 . Down from $1,599 to $1,369 initially, which already beats out the common $1,399 rate we’ve regularly seen this year, the bonus 5% savings lend towards cutting an additional $68 off the tag. While it has dipped a little lower in the past, you’re still getting a solid $298 markdown for the third-lowest price of the year.
***Note: We have not factored in the bonus savings into any of the prices you see below, so be sure to use the code EFBFCMAFF at checkout to guarantee you’re getting the best deals during this event. Just keep in mind that it may not be valid for select units.
Advertisement - scroll for more content
Popular options for your backup power needs:
DELTA 3 Max (2,048Wh) power station: $854 (Reg. $1,499)
2x DELTA 3 Classic (1,024Wh each) power stations: $889 (Reg. $1,198)
DELTA 3 Ultra (3,072Wh) power station: $1,369 (Reg. $1,599)
DELTA 3 Ultra (3,072Wh) with Smart Dual Fuel Generator 3000: $1,799 (No initial price cut)
TITAN 5000 (10kWh) with extra battery: $5,029 (Reg. $7,098)
You can shop EcoFlow’s full Black Friday power station sale right here .
EcoFlow 72-hour Black Friday flash sale offers DELTA 3800 Gen4 power station back at $1,614 low ($585 off), more
As part of EcoFlow’s freshly launched full Black Friday Sale , you can also find a 72-hour flash sale running, with up to $1,100 savings on four larger units – three of which are new releases! Things start with the DELTA 3800 Gen4 3,763Wh Portable Power Station down at $1,614.05 shipped , after using the sitewide bonus savings code EFBFCMAFF at checkout, beating Amazon by $85 . This is an all-new release that just hit the market at the top of the month with a $2,199 full price, which we saw launch at $1,699, while a bonus savings code dropped it to this same rate. The deal is repeating through this event, giving you a $585 markdown for its best price. Head below to check out the other exciting flash sale offers while they last.
***Note: The brand’s sitewide bonus savings code EFBFCMAFF can be used for an extra 5% off for the three DELTA Gen4 and TITAN Series offers you see below. That discount has not been factored into the prices listed.
EcoFlow’s 72-hour full Black Friday flash lineup:
DELTA 3800 Gen4 (3,763Wh) power station: $1,699 (Reg. $2,199)
TITAN 5000 Classic (5,018Wh) Whole-Home Backup System: $2,199 (Reg. $3,299)
TITAN TITAN 5000 with 2x 400W solar panels: $4,399 (Reg. $5,497)
DELTA Pro Ultra X (12kWh) with Smart Home Panel 3: $10,899 (Reg. $10,999)
Segway’s full Black Friday Sale drops Xyber Air smart e-bike to new $1,800 low with first discount, more from $135
With Amazon’s Black Friday event in full swing, Segway has launched its official Black Friday and Cyber Monday Sale with up to 57% savings on EVs. Alongside the Max G3 Plus e-scooter all-time low and continuing MUXI e-bike deal , the sale is giving us the first discount on the new Xyber Air Smart Electric Bike for $1,799.99 shipped . This new model just hit the market at the end of October, keeping to its full $2,000 rate until now. During this major sale, you’re getting $200 in first-ever savings cut from the tag for a new all-time low price.
You can browse through all Segway’s Black Friday e-scooter and e-bike deals right here .
Velotric’s expanded Black Friday Sale drops 39-pound Tempo city commuter e-bike to new $1,399 low, more from $1,299
Velotric has expanded its Black Friday EV Sale with additional deals and some increased savings on select models, like the 2026 Tempo Lightweight City Commuter e-bike down at $1,399 shipped . Down from $1,499, this model got its first-ever deal at the top of the month to $1,449, but the expanded sale here bumps things to a $100 markdown for a new all-time low price.
You can check out the expanded lineup of Velotric e-bike deals here .
EGO’s 56V 15-inch Multi-Head string trimmer combo kit returns to $300 2026 low with Black Friday savings, more
As part of Amazon’s Black Friday Sale event , you can find some solid EGO Power+ tool deals worth jumping on, like the EGO Power+ 56V Multi-Head Combo with Power Head, 15-inch String Trimmer attachment, and a 5.0Ah battery at $299.99 shipped . Down from $389, we’ve mostly seen discounts keep the price between $339 and $319 in 2026, though there were drops to $300 during both Prime Day events. Now, you’re getting a third annual chance at the best price of the year, saving you $89 off the going rate.
You can also check out the roundup of EGO Black Friday tool deals here .
